description: This file implements a chat handler class for a web-based chat system, including configuration, user session management, message processing, and JSON response generation.

classes.name: Chat
classes.description: A class managing chat operations such as message retrieval, user management, and message submission.

methods.name: Chat
methods.description: Constructor initializing chat session and handling different submode requests.

methods.name: getAJAX
methods.description: Returns the current JSON response for AJAX calls.

methods.name: setUserNick
methods.description: Initializes or updates the user's nickname and session in the database.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Generates a list of active users in JSON format.

methods.name: lastMsgId
methods.description: Updates the last message ID received from the client.

methods.name: getAllPVChat
methods.description: Retrieves private chat messages since last message ID.

methods.name: getPubChat
methods.description: Retrieves public chat messages since last message ID.

methods.name: msgParse
methods.description: Parses special commands within chat messages (e.g., change nick, date/time commands).

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Processes and stores a submitted chat message.

methods.name: pvClose
methods.description: Deletes private chat messages when a private chat is closed.
